findings.summary: Rust implements only a subset of Java CommandPackageWithUSymbol's symbol-container keyword set.
findings.details: Java accepts package, rectangle, hexagon, node, artifact, folder, file, frame, cloud, action, process, database, storage, component, card, queue, and stack in CommandPackageWithUSymbol. Rust SYMBOL_RE and looks_like_package_opener cover only package, namespace, cloud, database, folder, frame, rectangle, and node. Fresh Java-valid storage and artifact probes therefore do not use the class package command path in Rust.

findings.summary: try_entity_decl precedes try_package and consumes braced component/queue containers as entities.
findings.details: The class parser defers braced database/node/rectangle declarations to try_package, but not component or queue. Fresh Java-valid component and queue container probes render as class entities with body text instead of package clusters.

findings.summary: Malformed opener behavior is fail-closed only for the shortened Rust symbol list.
findings.details: The malformed node control returns the expected Rust ParseError, but the malformed storage control renders a DESCRIPTION entity. Java emits syntax-error SVGs for both.

findings.summary: No fixture-shaped logic or unexplained parity constants were found in the audited implementation diff.
findings.details: Searches for checker fixture labels, perturbation paths, and golden-specific conditionals found only test names/comments, not shipping parser branches. The rejection is a Java model coverage gap rather than evidence of per-fixture overfit.

findings.summary: The corrected account and implementation are consistent for the supported package/folder controls.
findings.details: Fresh package reverse-alias and folder reverse-alias controls both passed structurally and exercised command fallback, identity ownership, and trailing-stereotype ownership.
